# dsh-download-indicator
A draggable, semi-transparent download-progress widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — **it only a
ppears while something is actually downloading**.
Point it at one or more folders, and it watches large files there: when a file is still growing, the
widget fades in at the top-right corner showing its progress bar, downloaded size and **live speed*
*. When nothing is growing, it fades out and stays out of your way.
No configuration is needed for the common case — it defaults to watching `F:\ComfyUI\models` and `F:
\training\downloads`.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the client once (the desktop shell collects its index-injection table at startup), then refr
esh the page if you were already looking at it.
## Features
- **Shows up only when it matters** — polls every 2s; after two consecutive empty results it fades o

ut.
- **Draggable** — grab it anywhere and drop it where it doesn't cover your work. Position is rem

embered in `localStorage` and survives refreshes and restarts.
- **Live speed** — the server compare
s file sizes between polls, so the speed is measured, not guessed. The last three samples are averag

ed to keep the number readable.
- **Auto-discovery** — you don't declare each download. It scans the
watched folders (depth ≤ 3), keeps files over 20 MB with a known archive/model extension, and repor

ts the ones that are growing.
- **Stays in view** — it can't be dragged off-screen, and a window res

ize pulls it back if it ends up out of bounds.
- **Total speed** — the header shows the aggregate of

all active downloads.
- **Graceful without totals** — when the final size is unknown it shows an in
determinate striped bar plus the downloaded amount, instead of a fake percentage.
## Configuration
Everything is optional.
| Variable | Default | Meaning |
| `DSH_DOWNLOAD_WATCH` | `F:\ComfyUI\models;F:\training\downloads` | Semicolon-separated folders to
_DOWNLOAD_WATCH` | `F:\ComfyUI\models;F:\training\downloads` | Semicolon-separated folders to scan |
Known total sizes (for the percentage) live in `KNOWN_TOTALS` inside `lib/index.js`, keyed by lower-
cased file name. Unknown files simply show progress without a percentage.
Tune these constants at the top of `lib/index.js` if your setup differs:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## How it works
Two halves, because the desktop client only accepts one kind of injection:
1. **Server** (`lib/index.js`) registers two routes on the DSH web server — `/dsh-download/status` (
JSON: active downloads, sizes, speeds) and `/dsh-download/widget.js` (the client script) — and pushe

s a single structured index-injection row so the script gets loaded.
2. **Client** (`assets/widget.j
s`) builds the floating element, polls the status route, and renders.
The injection deliberately uses an **inline `script` row rather than a `script-src` row**: a failed
`script-src` load rejects the client boot outright, so a missing route would take the whole UI down
with it. The inline row creates the `<script>` tag itself and swallows `onerror`, which means this p
lugin can never prevent the client from starting.
